remarks: OVER 2,300 SQ FT,  4 BEDROOMS , AND A HUGE CORNER LOT... THIS IS THE OPPORTUNITY YOU'VE BEEN WAITING FOR! If you've been waiting for a home where you can build equity and make it your own, this is one you won't want to miss! Offering over 2,300 sq ft, 4 bedrooms and 2 full baths, this spacious Angola home gives you the room that's getting harder to find at this price point. Inside you'll find generously sized rooms, an eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, large living room, first-floor laundry and full bath, plus an additional first-floor flex room perfect for an office, den or playroom. Upstairs features four spacious bedrooms and another full bath. Outside, the large corner lot offers plenty of room to enjoy, along with covered porches, ample parking, space to build a garage and two storage sheds.  Bring your own style and updates to the interior. Minutes from Lake Erie, multiple beaches within walking distance, the state park, dining and Route 5. So much space, so much potential, and an opportunity to make this home exactly what YOU want it to be. Come see the possibilities!
